endpoints.summary:
Finds attachments in the brain whose location matches the provided value.
Works for external URLs, external files, and external directories.
            
For URL attachments (type 3, the default), matching ignores the http/https
scheme and any trailing slash, and the rest of the location must match
exactly, case included (so `https://x.com/p`, `http://x.com/p` and
`x.com/p/` all find each other, but `X.com/p` does not).
For file and directory attachments, the location is the file-system path.
            
Useful for de-duplicating web-capture tools or finding every thought
that references a given file.

Thought properties and values:
            
    Guid 'id' - The ID of the thought
    Guid 'brainId' - The ID of the brain containing the thought
    Guid 'typeId' - The ID of the thought type
            
    DateTime 'creationDateTime' - The DateTime that the thought was created at
    DateTime 'modificationDateTime' - The DateTime that the thought was last modified at
    DateTime 'forgottenDateTime' - The DateTime that the thought was forgotten at
    DateTime 'linksModificationDateTime' - The DateTime that the thought's links were last modified at
            
    string 'name' - The Name of the thought
    string 'label' - The Label of the thought
    string[] 'aliases' - Alternate names of the thought, matched by search and mention recognition (empty when none)
    string 'foregroundColor' - The RGB hexadecimal color of the thought's foreground color (Ex: '#ff7145')
    string 'backgroundColor' - The RGB hexadecimal color of the thought's background color (Ex: '#ff7145')
            
    int 'acType' - The access type of the thought
         Public = 0
         Private = 1
            
    int 'kind' - The kind of thought
         Normal = 1
         Type = 2
         Event = 3
         Tag = 4
         System = 5

endpoints.summary: Updates a thought using JSON Patch
endpoints.description:
Thought properties and expected values:
            
    Guid 'typeId' (Optional) - The ID of the thought type
            
    string 'name' - The Name of the thought
    string 'label' (Optional)  - The Label of the thought
    string[] 'aliases' (Optional) - Alternate names of the thought. 'replace' or 'add' sets the whole list and
         'remove' clears it; element paths such as '/aliases/0' are not accepted. Aliases are trimmed, deduplicated
         case-insensitively, dropped when equal to the name, and capped at 100. Saving the first alias in a brain
         makes the brain require TheBrain 15.0.621 or later on every device.
    string 'foregroundColor' (Optional)  - The RGB hexadecimal color of the thought's foreground color (Ex: '#ff7145')
    string 'backgroundColor' (Optional)  - The RGB hexadecimal color of the thought's background color (Ex: '#ff7145')
            
    int 'acType' - The access type of the thought
         Public = 0
         Private = 1
            
    int 'kind' - The kind of thought
         Normal = 1
         Type = 2
         Event = 3
         Tag = 4
         System = 5
